zones.what: Lifeboats are mounted at Deck 7; they obstruct the downward view from Decks 7, 8, and 9 aft cabins while the horizon remains visible.
zones.effect: You lose the view of the waterline and sea immediately below, but can still see out to the horizon and watch sunsets or ports from your balcony.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests who want to watch the ship move through water or see tender operations; does not matter to those focused on horizon views, sunsets, or simply having outdoor space.

zones.what: Deck 17 and 18 Icon Loft Suites and Royal Loft Suite sit directly above, with multi-level occupancy.
zones.effect: You may hear footsteps or movement from the loft suites above, particularly if occupants use the upper levels frequently.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers in Deck 16 suites; less relevant to those who sleep soundly or are out of the cabin during the day.

zones.what: The Royal Promenade, Royal Theater, and central atrium are located on Deck 6, directly below portions of Deck 7, with evening activity extending to around 11 PM or midnight.
zones.effect: You may hear muffled music, announcements, or crowd noise from entertainment venues two decks below during evening hours.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to early sleepers or those sensitive to distant ambient noise; does not matter to night owls or those who enjoy being near the action.

zones.what: Thrill Island waterpark and AquaDome pool area are located on Deck 16 and 17, directly above Deck 14.
zones.effect: You may hear daytime splash noise, music, and pool activity from above, typically from morning until early evening.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to those wanting midday quiet in the cabin; does not matter to guests who are out exploring during the day or enjoy the energy of being near pool decks.

zones.what: Engine room and propulsion machinery are located low and aft, several decks below Deck 7 and 8 aft sections.
zones.effect: You may feel low-frequency vibration or hear a distant hum, particularly during maneuvering, though modern stabilization minimizes this on Icon class.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to those highly sensitive to vibration; most guests on these decks report minimal disturbance on this ship class.

zones.what: Bow thrusters are located low and forward, used during docking and maneuvering in port.
zones.effect: You may hear a loud rumble or feel vibration during port arrivals and departures, typically early morning or late afternoon, lasting 15-30 minutes.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers during port days; does not matter to those already awake or who sleep through mechanical noise.

zones.what: Anchor chain runs through the bow, deployed and retrieved in port.
zones.effect: You will hear loud metallic grinding and chain noise during anchor operations, typically early morning arrivals at tender ports, lasting 10-20 minutes.
zones.mattersTo: Matters significantly to anyone wanting to sleep past 6 or 7 AM on tender port days; unavoidable in forward cabins on these decks.
